failures.evidence: Red test TestRepeatedAwarenessFloodsDoNotGrowARoomsAwarenessWithoutLimit in packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/docs/awareness_flood_bound_test.go (commit 0cc7fe8a). Command: cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<url> go test -run TestRepeatedAwarenessFloodsDoNotGrowARoomsAwarenessWithoutLimit ./internal/dispatch/docs. At b0a2d131 it fails 2 of 2: 'task A's room tracks 16384 client entries, want at most 512' and 'task B's room tracks 5120 client entries'. At d7ceabb4, where ygo's MaxAwarenessClientsPerRoom is set, it passes 2 of 2 with 256 on each room. On two real binaries, one tab on A sent 40 frames of 10,000 new client ids each in about 6 s. VmRSS on A went from 54 to 312 MB, and to 404 MB 50 s after the flood began. On B it went from 56 to 108 MB once the expiries were relayed as removals. Null-state frames took A from 56 to 112 MB. At d7ceabb4 the same flood left A at 66 MB and B at 58 MB. Cause: b0a2d131 leaves ygo's client bound unset. The byte bound counts live states only, so every invented id stays in the room's map, live or as a tombstone, until it is purged 60 s after removal. On B, every relayed removal of a client B never held is stored as a tombstone. The fix must pass this test and TestAReaderJoiningAfterAnAwarenessFloodIsSeenOnTheOtherProcess together.
